tokens.name: cm-paper
tokens.usage: The ground. White in a Paper section, black in an Ink section. A page alternates the two; set data-theme on the section.

tokens.name: cm-ink
tokens.usage: All text, every border, every status, and the fill of the one primary button, on cm-paper and cm-wash. Nothing that is not a drink is ever any other color.

tokens.name: cm-on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a cm-ink fill: the Open pill, the primary button, today's row, a pressed chip.

tokens.name: cm-edge
tokens.usage: The outline of a freestanding flavor block or photo against the section it sits in. Same value as cm-ink, but it does not change inside a flavor, so yellow holds its shape on white and berry holds on black.

tokens.name: cm-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cm-paper and cm-wash: styles, captions, freshness stamps, the Closed pill. Not used on a flavor fill.

tokens.name: cm-wash
tokens.usage: Wells and disabled controls on cm-paper: a closed day, a kicked tap, an empty photo slot.

tokens.name: cm-hairline
tokens.usage: The thin divider between rows in a list. Decorative only; anything tappable is edged in cm-ink.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-red
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, red: cherry, strawberry. A drink only. Hue taken from the brewery's own photo of a flight. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-pink
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, hot pink: pink lemonade, raspberry, guava, punch. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-coral
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, coral: grapefruit, rosé, passion fruit. Hue taken from a photo of a pour at the bar. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-orange
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, orange: orange, creamsicle. Hue taken from the flight photo. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-mango
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, mango gold: peach, mango, pineapple-orange. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-yellow
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, yellow: lemon, pineapple. Hue taken from the flight photo. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-lime
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, lime: lime, ginger-lime, cucumber. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-green
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, green: melon, kiwi, green apple. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-aqua
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, aqua: for the next tropical blue. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-blue
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, blue: blue raspberry. Takes cm-on-flavor-light text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-purple
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, purple: grape, mixed berry. Hue taken from the purple seltzer cans. Takes cm-on-flavor-light text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-berry
tokens.usage: Seltzer color, deep berry: boysenberry, plum, blackberry. Hue taken from the flight photo. Takes cm-on-flavor-light text.

tokens.name: cm-flavor-clear
tokens.usage: A seltzer with no fruit color. It pours cloudy and pale, not clear, so it gets this instead of white. Takes cm-on-flavor-dark text.

tokens.name: cm-on-flavor-dark
tokens.usage: Text, buttons and dots on the nine bright flavors (red through aqua), and on beer shades 1 to 3. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-on-flavor-light
tokens.usage: Text, buttons and dots on the three deep flavors (blue, purple, berry), and on beer shades 4 to 6. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-beer-1
tokens.usage: Beer shade 1, palest: pilsner, Kölsch, rice lager. Beer is shown in black and white, by how dark it pours. Data only, always ringed in cm-ink.

tokens.name: cm-beer-2
tokens.usage: Beer shade 2: pale ale, IPA, hazy. Data only.

tokens.name: cm-beer-3
tokens.usage: Beer shade 3: amber, red ale, red IPA. Data only.

tokens.name: cm-beer-4
tokens.usage: Beer shade 4: brown ale, bock. Data only.

tokens.name: cm-beer-5
tokens.usage: Beer shade 5: porter. Data only.

tokens.name: cm-beer-6
tokens.usage: Beer shade 6, darkest: stout. Data only.

styles.name: cm-sign-xl
styles.usage: Condensed. One per page: the answer at the top of Home and Visit.

styles.name: cm-sign-lg
styles.usage: Condensed. Page titles and the age-gate question.

styles.name: cm-sign-md
styles.usage: Condensed. Section and card titles, beer names on a label, the day in a date block.

styles.name: cm-sign-sm
styles.usage: Condensed. Status pills, notice labels, the brewery name set in plain type.

styles.name: cm-shout-xl
styles.usage: Wide. A seltzer's name on its own color, on screens 720px and wider. Never on a phone and never in black and white.

styles.name: cm-shout
styles.usage: Wide. A seltzer's name on its own color, anywhere. The wide face is reserved for flavor.

styles.name: cm-lede
styles.sample: A tiny taproom with twelve taps and long bars.
styles.usage: One sentence under a page title.

styles.name: cm-body
styles.sample: Long bars, a few tables, twelve taps.
styles.usage: Default copy. The floor for anything a visitor must read to act.

styles.name: cm-body-strong
styles.usage: Drink names in a list, button labels, today's row.

styles.name: cm-label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, group headings, tags.

styles.name: cm-data-lg
styles.usage: The ABV column, big numbers a visitor compares.

styles.name: cm-data
styles.usage: Hours, styles with ABV, distances, dates.

tokens.name: cm-space-1
tokens.usage: Dot to label; tag padding.

tokens.name: cm-space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags and chips; the height of the flight strip.

tokens.name: cm-space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; label to field.

tokens.name: cm-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and page margin on phones.

tokens.name: cm-space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; between stacked cards.

tokens.name: cm-space-6
tokens.usage: Section title to content.

tokens.name: cm-space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: cm-space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on wider screens; the date block.

tokens.name: cm-radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything with corners: cards, buttons, inputs, tags, photos, color blocks. The system is square.

tokens.name: cm-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only things that report a state or filter a list: status pills, filter chips, dots, drink chips.

tokens.name: cm-rule
tokens.usage: The heavy rule. Every border on a card, control, photo and color block.

tokens.name: cm-rule-thin
tokens.usage: Row dividers in a list, in cm-hairline.

tokens.name: cm-tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: cm-bar-height
tokens.usage: The sticky action bar on phones; reserve this much bottom padding.

tokens.name: cm-content-max
tokens.usage: Widest the page content runs.

tokens.name: cm-measure
tokens.usage: Widest a paragraph runs.
